overview_description.description:
With Hutsy, experience home buying that is streamlined, convenient and transparent.

Home buying has been stuck in the previous century, leading to unnecessary costs and stress. So much like a neobank, we’ve built Hutsy to be a new way to buy a home.

about_short_description.short_description: Hutsy is a new way to buy a home for the modern home buyer.

product.name: Hutsy Home Buying Platform
product.description: A digital and in-person service that guides home buyers through the entire home purchase process, from searching for homes to closing the sale.

product.name: Local Concierge Service
product.description: A service that connects home buyers with vetted local agents, lenders, title officers, and inspectors to manage the home buying process.

identifier.value: Online Home Search and Scheduling Tools

product.name: Online Home Search and Scheduling Tools
product.description: Web-based tools that enable users to search for homes, save favorites, schedule showings, and manage appointments online.

identifier.value: Online Offer Submission and Negotiation Support

product.name: Online Offer Submission and Negotiation Support
product.description: A feature that allows buyers to submit offers on homes digitally and receive guidance on negotiating purchase terms.

product.name: Digital Closing and Document Signing
product.description: An online service that facilitates viewing, signing, and managing all closing documents required to finalize a home purchase.
